description: A crowded indoor arena with a lit stage at left, small figures on it and light beams in red, blue and gold. A large American flag hangs from the high ceiling at centre. In the foreground a firefighter in a black helmet and turnout coat with yellow reflective stripes raises one fist holding a small flag, with uniformed police officers in peaked caps beside him. Many people in the crowd wave small American flags. Modern dress and stage rigging, no visible text apart from small uniform shoulder patches, no frame.
